title: Add distributed role setup dialogs
summary: Add WebView-only coordinator and worker setup dialogs that open when the operator changes NetworkRole away from standalone.
reason: Worker and coordinator setup fields are not obvious from the current saved worker mode settings panel. Operators need role-specific walkthroughs while preserving backend-owned settings preview/save and lifecycle boundaries.
behavior_before: Changing NetworkRole to worker or coordinator only marked the generic Workers settings builder dirty; the operator had to infer which fields mattered for the selected distributed role.
behavior_after: Changing NetworkRole to worker or coordinator opens a role-specific in-app setup dialog. The dialog stages existing saved settings fields through the current backend Preview/Save flow and does not expose lifecycle controls or auth-token fields.
